verdict.rationale: Stripe documents that every fund movement creates a Transaction object serving as ledger entries, explicitly recommended for reconciling against internal systems (docs-13, docs-19), but there is no documented daily reconciliation cadence, audit report, or explicit guarantee that the ledger matches actual bank-held balances—the exact assurance the Synapse collapse exposed as missing. Community evidence (comm-10) shows a bank-partner security incident touched Stripe Treasury customers, underscoring that reconciliation-with-bank-core risk is a live concern rather than a solved, documented process. missing for 10: explicit daily bank-core reconciliation process/cadence, third-party or regulatory attestation of ledger-to-bank matching, and direct rebuttal of Synapse-style ledger/bank mismatch risk.
